title: Acclaimed artist Reinke releases a vibrant song, "Jedi," from EP "Saga."
htmlContent:
Reinke returns with a new single, "Jedi," a Hip Hop sound engaging with the right portion of bounce to it that he takes over ideally. The single "Jedi" from his new album, "Sage EP," has proven to be his best professional effort.

Reinke's EP showcased his 5 track project that featured songs such as "Jedi," "Check the Vitals," and "Earl Campbel." While doing the project, the acclaimed artist Reinke spent countless hours in the studio. Finding his sound and displaying his lyrical ability. As the rising superstar continues to uphold his authentic personality, he is soon hooked to conquer the airwaves.
